issuer: the Arizona Department of Transportation, Motor Vehicle Division (MVD)
note: Arizona's statutes on azleg.gov (read 2026-10-30): A.R.S. § 28-3002 sets the fee for an original or renewed class D licence by age, $25 at 39 or younger (the fee held, the age a first licence is mostly got at; $20 at 40 to 44, $15 at 45 to 49, $10 from 50); § 28-3171 makes a licence valid until the holder's 65th birthday, held as the age it ends at, with no fixed term (validYears null); § 28-3174 gives a person under 18 a class G (graduated) licence, so the full class D is held from 18. § 28-3165 has the department issue a nonoperating identification license to anyone without a licence and set its fee by rule; ADOT's own pages and the Arizona Administrative Code (apps.azsos.gov) both refused the request behind a Cloudflare check on 2026-10-30, so the card's fee and term are null. Not held: the age-banded fees past 39, the licence of up to five years first issued from 60 (§ 28-3171(A)(3), a most, not a term), the photo renewal ADOT asks every 12 years. On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the age the licence ends at, 65: until then it held no term and no age. From 2026-10-30 (the lead, when a term could run to an age) the licence holds A.R.S. 28-3002's fees by the applicant's age as terms each running to the 65th birthday (28-3171): $25 to 39, $20 at 40 to 44, $15 at 45 to 49, $10 from 50; until then it held the $25 alone.

sources.title: A.R.S. § 28-3002, Fees; driver licenses
sources.said: 2. Except as provided in paragraph 1, for each original, renewal or reinstatement application for a class D, G or M license: Age Fee 50 or older $10.00 45-49 $15.00 40-44 $20.00 39 or younger $25.00

sources.title: A.R.S. § 28-3171, Driver license expiration and renewal
sources.said: valid until the applicant's sixty-fifth birthday.

sources.title: A.R.S. § 28-3174, Class G driver licenses
sources.said: A person who is under eighteen years of age may apply to the department for a class G driver license

sources.title: A.R.S. § 28-3165, Nonoperating identification license
sources.said: the department shall issue a nonoperating identification license ... The department shall adopt rules and establish fees for issuance of a nonoperating identification license
